versions.name: Camp Sol R. Crown
versions.summary: A year-round Northeast Illinois Council camp in Trevor, southeastern Wisconsin, with cabins and open camping areas that host unit campouts and Cub Scout camporees.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Camp Sol R. Crown site. Confirmed as a current Northeast Illinois Council camp in Trevor, Wisconsin. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
